Susdera is a necromancer[1] of the Cult of Myrkul. She is atop Moonrise Towers, and assists  Ketheric Thorm in battle against the party.

Involvement

If the party proceed to the rooftop of Moonrise Towers after completing ⁠Find Ketheric Thorm's Relic (i.e., freeing or killing the  Nightsong and thus ending Ketheric's immortality), a cutscene with him is triggered followed by fight against him and his allies. Susdera is then one of Ketheric's allies in battle against the party.

If the party proceed to the rooftop of Moonrise Towers before completing ⁠Find Ketheric Thorm's Relic, Susdera stops and admonishes them to turn back. Answering "I go where I wish" causes her and all eight Necromites to turn hostile.  Ketheric Thorm does not become hostile unless a party member gets too close to him. However, he cannot be defeated this time because he is still immortal.

Unlike the Zealots, Adepts, and other members of the Cult of the Absolute, it appears Susdera and other Mistresses of Souls are fully aware of what the Absolute is and the religious hoax they're perpetrating.[2] This greater understanding (and accompanying disdain) is shared by the other high-ranking Myrkulite necromancers serving General Thorm, with  Kressa Bonedaughter bemoaning the weak servility of the infected she is presented with, and  Balthazar using the player character's worm-infested status as an expletive.
